title: What are Functions?
overview: Functions are reusable blocks of code that perform a specific task. They help organize code and avoid repeating the same logic multiple times.

title: Creating and Calling Functions
overview: Functions are created using the def keyword and executed by calling their name followed by parentheses.

title: Function Parameters
overview: Parameters allow functions to receive values from outside. They make functions more flexible and reusable.

title: Return Values
overview: Functions can return results using the return keyword. Returned values can be stored in variables or used in calculations.

example.title: Return Example

title: Default Arguments
overview: Default arguments provide a default value to parameters when no value is passed during function calling.

title: Lambda Functions
overview: Lambda functions are small anonymous functions written in a single line. They are useful for simple operations.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how to create functions, pass parameters, return values, use default arguments, and create lambda functions in Python.
